name: desk-mcp
description: Windows desktop automation MCP server: screenshots, OCR, mouse and keyboard input, and element trees from UI Automation, MSAA and Chrome DevTools Protocol. Zero external binaries.
long_description: 46 tools for Windows desktop automation over stdio. A long-lived PowerShell worker provides UI Automation, MSAA, OCR and WinAPI input. Separate CDP tools control Chrome/Edge. No native npm modules or separate build toolchain required.
